criteria_results.criterion: AC1: Each pre-commit test creates .commit-approved before git commit and removes it in teardown
criteria_results.evidence: library/cursor/hooks/validate-hooks.sh lines 254-320: COMMIT_GATE=.cursor/hooks/.commit-approved. Three commit-allow tests (lines 266-272, 294-300, 307-313) each rm -f flag before, echo approved > flag before hook invocation, rm -f after. Deny test (285-292) intentionally omits flag. Final rm -f at line 320. Non-commit test (256-262) does not invoke git commit — flag not required.

criteria_results.criterion: AC2: No previously-passing test removed or assertions weakened
criteria_results.evidence: git comm -23/13 on pass() messages: two renames (harness-context, pre-commit allow) correspond to the five previously-failing cases per contract, not dropped passing tests. One new pass added: pre-commit denies without flag. Script pass() count HEAD=32 → working=33. Clean run: 37 passed (≥36), 0 failed. No fail() branches removed.

criteria_results.criterion: AC3: harness-gate test fix reflects actual hook output
criteria_results.evidence: Standalone run with contract test prompt (state/contract/.routing-pending cleared): followup_message contains HARNESS ROUTING and /planner instruction. Test assertion (line 236): rg HARNESS ROUTING|followup_message.*planner — matches. Prompt length >100 chars; old short prompt was the documented failure cause.

criteria_results.criterion: AC4: validate-hooks.sh 100% pass, zero failures on clean run
criteria_results.evidence: bash library/cursor/hooks/validate-hooks.sh from repo root (after restoring .cursor/hooks from library): exit 0, Summary: 37 passed, 0 failed, 0 warnings. No ✗ lines in output.

edge_case_results.case: EC1: Missing .cursor/hooks/ — clear prerequisite error, not bash crash
edge_case_results.evidence: With .cursor/hooks moved aside: exit 1, prints Prerequisites missing, lists .cursor/hooks/ directory not found, suggests make setup/sync-local, Summary: Cannot run — missing prerequisites. No set -e trace or file-not-found from hook script paths.

edge_case_results.case: EC2: Stale .commit-approved from interrupted run — idempotent cleanup
edge_case_results.evidence: Pre-run: echo stale > .cursor/hooks/.commit-approved. Post full validate-hooks.sh (exit 0): file absent (FLAG_GONE). All six pre-commit subsection tests passed including deny-without-flag.
